subject: Renewal: Private env expansion + isolation & regional forking
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal question + request: private env expansion and stronger isolation

Hi Diego,

As we approach our renewal window (current term expires 2026-09-30), the infra team has signaled an urgent need to expand our Private deployment footprint and tighten isolation between analytics and production workloads. High-level asks: 
- Add two additional isolated clusters (EU) dedicated to analytics (separate VPC / routing)
- Strict tenancy isolation: separate KMS keys and no cross-tenant read access
- Option to add a third small cluster as a warm standby for failover (budget permitting)
- We'd like contract/terms updated to reflect 24-month committed term with staging credits for the first 3 months to help offset migration effort

Can your team confirm feasibility and deliver a rough timeline and delta pricing by next week? Procurement wants the updated SOW and price to begin PO routing in early August.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Operations
NovaMed Health

(attachment: current_deployment_inventory.csv (text/csv))

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal question + request: private env expansion and stronger isolation

Elena —

Thanks for the clear summary. This is feasible; appreciate the detail. Quick responses below and next steps: 

Feasibility & topology
- We can provision two dedicated EU clusters for analytics with full network isolation and separate KMS instances.
- Warm standby cluster is possible as a reserved smaller pool (we'd recommend 1/4 the capacity of a production cluster).

Timeline
- Provisioning + security attestations: 6–8 weeks once SOW is signed and infra payment clears.
- If you need faster delivery (4 weeks), we can do a prioritized slot but it will incur an expedited provisioning surcharge.

Commercials
- I'll put together a delta quote reflecting 24-month term discounts, staging credits for months 1–3, and optional warm-standby pricing.

Next steps
1) I'll loop in Monica (SE) for topology and capacity verification.
2) Can you share the procurement contact and preferred PO terms?
3) I'll send a draft SOW and a quote for review by EOD next Wednesday (2026-07-15).

I'll attach our SOW template to the next message.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Enterprise 
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal question + request: private env expansion and stronger isolation

Elena / Diego —

Following up with technical specifics to inform the SOW/quote: 
- Proposed topology: two isolated eu-west-1 clusters (analytics-a, analytics-b) in separate subnets + isolated NATs. No peering; routing through a controlled egress gateway.
- KMS: recommend customer-managed key per cluster (we support AWS KMS import or external HSM via KMIP).
- KV cache separation: we will provision separate cache namespaces; no cross-cluster KV replication.

Capacity sizing: based on the inventory you shared, each analytics cluster recommended: 4x A40-equivalent nodes (burst to 6 for batch windows). Warm standby: 1x A40-equivalent node.

Operational notes / deliverables we will include in the SOW:
- Provisioning plan + runbook (network ACLs, firewall rules, KMS setup)
- Security evidence: SOC2 attestation extract + configuration checklist for isolation controls
- Delivery milestones: design signoff, provisioning start, canary test window, live cutover

Constraints: standard lead time for custom KMS hookups to external HSMs is 10 business days after keys are handed over. If NovaMed needs managed KMS with rotation integrated into Redwood, that adds 1 week.

I'll prepare a short network diagram and a list of required inputs for your infra team.

—Monica
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Diego / Monica / Elena —

Thanks for the draft. A few legal/ops items before we can finalize: 
- MSA redline: we can accept most edits but need one clarification on data residency clauses in §4.3 — please confirm that analytics clusters will be physically provisioned in eu-west-1 and not replicated outside EU.
- SLA / support: NovaMed requested 99.95% SLAs for production clusters. We can offer 99.9% for analytics clusters as configured; for 99.95% we need to add redundancy (extra node) and a slightly higher monthly fee.
- KMS & keys: for customer-managed KMS, provide contact and secure key-transfer timeline (10 business days). If you need HSM integration, legal requires an interop addendum — add ~2 weeks.
- Lead time: ops strongly recommends 60 calendar days from signed SOW to production cutover given custom KMS and network approvals. If procurement needs earlier, we can propose a phased cutover with one cluster live first.

Please confirm the above so I can approve DocuSign package and finalize commercial terms.

Marissa Cole
Director, Contracts & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
